ideas.pitch: A dashboard that analyzes open-source repositories using real GitHub and Git workflows to score contribution health, issue-to-merge velocity, and maintainer bottleneck zones.
ideas.title: GitMetrics Open Source Health Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core open-source collaboration and GitHub workflow focus of Winter of Code 2026, helping maintainers optimize how they process contributions.

ideas.pitch: An open-source CLI and GitHub Action that reads pull requests, automatically flags stale or missing documentation, and drafts suggested fixes using lightweight RAG.
ideas.title: DocuPatch: AI-Driven Documentation & Issue Auto-Tagger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the exact documentation improvement pain point highlighted in the hackathon description, appealing heavily to open-source maintainers judging the event.

ideas.pitch: A matching platform that maps a developer's local Git commit history and language skills to beginner-friendly 'good first issues' across participating open-source projects.
ideas.title: IssueSync Multi-Repo Contributor Matcher
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the hackathon's explicit mission to help students and developers get started with real-world software development and open-source contribution.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight cryptographic verification tool that proves code contribution authorship and integrity without exposing private fork source code.
ideas.title: CommitTrace ZK-Provenance for Open Source Contributions
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings genuinely hard engineering to an open-source event, standing out among basic web apps by solving contribution authenticity and attribution.

ideas.pitch: A specialized AI agent that integrates into GitHub workflows to perform automated style-guide checks, security vulnerability scanning, and plain-English architectural explanations for pull requests.
ideas.title: OpenReview AI-Powered PR Review Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages proven multi-agent RAG patterns seen in top hackathon wins while directly serving the real-world collaboration workflows emphasized in Winter of Code.
